title: qfer-preflight batch envelope, schema version 1
description: The document produced when `qfer-preflight check` is given more than one input, or a directory. The envelope carries one entry per input and aggregates nothing: findings never merge across inputs and no count in the envelope sums across them. Each entry whose outcome is `validated` embeds a complete single-report document conforming to the report schema of the same major version (docs/schemas/report-v1.schema.json); this file does not duplicate that schema's definitions, and the test suite cross-validates every embedded report against it.

report.description: A complete single-report document. Must conform to docs/schemas/report-v1.schema.json; the suite enforces that by validating real embedded reports against it.
